task: Add per-membership default-project support (is_default flag, set/clear endpoints, and schema migration) for EPMCDME-15110

component_scope.label: L
component_scope.affected: UserProjectRepository, UserProject/ProjectInfo models, user_management_router (set/clear default endpoints), UserAccessService, AuthenticationService, RegistrationService, UserManagementService

requirements_clarity.label: S
requirements_clarity.gaps: No major gaps; two code-review follow-ups (CR-001 concurrency-conflict handling, CR-002 audit logging of project_name) were addressed with dedicated tests, indicating minor refinement during review rather than ambiguous original requirements.

technical_risk.label: M
technical_risk.risk_factors: New swap-old-for-new default transaction pattern backed by a partial unique index (uix_user_projects_one_default); concurrent set_default calls can race and must surface as clean HTTP errors rather than raw 500s
technical_risk.mitigation: IntegrityError mapped to 409, StaleDataError/ObjectDeletedError mapped to 404; DB-level partial unique index backstops the app-level transaction; dedicated concurrency and audit-logging test classes (CR-001, CR-002) added; new endpoints reuse the existing admin_or_maintainer_access_only authorization dependency rather than introducing new authz logic

key_reasoning.reason: Cross-cutting change: 3 new repository methods, shared UserProject/ProjectInfo model updates, 2 new router endpoints, and 4 service files that thread the new is_default field through login, registration, access-management, and admin-list flows.
13 files changed (9 modified, 4 new) — diffstat 727 insertions(+)/8 deletions(-) — spanning repository, models, router, 4 service files, an Alembic migration, and 5 test files across 8 directories.
Touches API, Service, Repository, and DB-Persistence layers; includes an additive schema migration (new column + partial unique index enforcing at-most-one-default-per-user).
